tagline: Evidence-Gated Civic Web Accessibility Auditing with Strands Decider 2B Policy Gatekeeping

hackathon_classification.required_credit: Built with the AWS User Group Madurai Strands Decider hackathon kit

core_stack.database: SQLite (WAL mode, parameterized schema in accesslens/db.py)
core_stack.decision_endpoint: POST /v1/decide (AWS User Group Madurai hosted API)

downstream_branches.output: CivicAuditorEscalationTicket (4-step manual assistive technology evaluation protocol)

security_safeguards.ssrf_protection: Multi-layered pre-flight DNS and IP validation

human_review_safeguards.wcag_scope_disclosure: Axe-core identifies a subset of machine-detectable criteria; zero violations does not certify full WCAG compliance
manual_testing_protocol: Screen reader flow verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)
Keyboard-only navigation and focus indicator visibility

bedrock_status.latency_note: Observed round-trip latency of approximately 5.1 seconds on a single application-level request; explicitly noted as an empirical observation, not a formal performance benchmark.

policy_gate_result.gate_status: Classified as HUMAN_REVIEW at 19.41% confidence, below the 70% threshold; automated code patching locked

bedrock_status.bedrock_role: Advisory remediation guidance and contextual explanation; does not override policy gate or mutate code
bedrock_status.fallback_safeguard: Static WCAG guidance and manual escalation tickets when LLM_PROVIDER=disabled, credentials missing, or on timeout
bedrock_status.note: One application-level request through POST /api/findings/analyze successfully invoked Amazon Nova Pro (us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0) in us-east-1. Strands Decider 2B classified the finding as HUMAN_REVIEW at 19.41% confidence while Bedrock generated advisory remediation guidance with an observed latency of ~5.1s (an observation, not a benchmark). Default execution remains offline with LLM_PROVIDER=disabled at zero cloud cost.

benchmark_disclosure.note: Single-call response latency on the hosted Decider endpoint reflects internet round-trip to the AWS User Group Madurai hosted server. Similarly, the ~5.1s Bedrock invocation is an empirical single-request observation, not a performance benchmark. No synthetic benchmark numbers or claims.
